description: Points recharges électriques parkings is a dataset listed in Saemes OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Saemes. Retrouvez dans ce jeu de données l'ensembles des points de recharge des parkings. Et notamment: - les bornes intelligentes (22 KW) permettant un rechargement rapide (payant). Les tarifs et les modes de paiement sont indiqués. Coverage: Paris region (Saemes car parks). The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are Parking public, borne de rechargement électrique, Paris, Ile-de-France, Stationnement, Se garer. The portal shows 54 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-saemes-fr-portal.
